news.title: trunk/79ef85d9b61ab6dff4da6790dc21aef835b57a58: [inductor] decompose_addmm skips non-default alpha and beta (#196588)
news.dek:
Issue 
 Fixes  #196577 
 Summary 
 decompose_addmm  matched  aten.addmm  without declaring  beta  or  alpha , and the pattern matcher only compares the kwargs a pattern declares, so  addmm(x, a, b, beta=0)  was rewritten to  a @ b + x . The pattern now pins  beta=1, alpha=1 : nod
news.aiSummary: The decompose_addmm function previously matched aten.addmm operations without declaring beta or alpha parameters, causing incorrect rewrites when non-default values were used. This update pins beta and alpha to 1 to prevent the pattern matcher from incorrectly rewriting operations with custom coefficients.
